secondary_analysis: global level calibration: multiply each model's predictions by that model's O/E factor on 2019–2020 (factor locked here); reported under the same criteria H1a–H1c, not used for the primary decision
primary_comparison: EAGB (simultaneous HCE) vs Tweedie GLM (primary baseline)

H1b.rule: jointly: |OE_E-1| <= |OE_G-1| + 0.05; |slope_E-1| <= |slope_G-1| + 0.10; maxdec_E <= maxdec_G + 0.10 (point estimates on the test set)

H1_overall: supported when H1a, H1b and H1c all hold; tested in the order H1a -> H1b -> H1c -> GT2

H2a.stat: ratio of normalised dispersion, Owen / Shapley-group-sum, under model noise (8 county-cluster bootstraps, 100 points)

H2.H2a_secondary: same criteria for background noise (descriptive, not used for decisions)
H2.fidelity_NI: mean fidelity R2 of Owen is not lower than that of Shapley by more than 0.05
H2.H2_overall: supported (partially, excluding H2c) when H2a and H2b both hold

H3.stat: ratio of weighted variances of Δlog Π (conservative/nominal), pooled 2021–2023, mean over 5 seeds; county-cluster bootstrap B=1000
H3.TOST: expected profit: one-sided 95% lower bound (t, over seeds) of (cons-nom)/|nom| > -0.02; renewal: lower bound of (cons-nom) > -0.005
H3.H3_overall: supported when the variance ratio holds and both TOST conditions hold

RQ0: at least one of (H1a, H2a, H3 variance ratio) is supported AND no axis violates its non-inferiority condition (H1b; fidelity_NI; TOST)
